parsed_entries.requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must record its reasons in writing for not disposing of an application or appeal within ninety days.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Appellate Tribunal provides written reasons for delays in disposing of applications or appeals beyond ninety days.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to cases where the Appellate Tribunal fails to dispose of an application or appeal within ninety days.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement is directly tied to the procedural obligation of the Appellate Tribunal to provide written reasons for delays.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Appellate Tribunal must consist of a Chairperson and not more than two Members appointed by the Central Government.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the Appellate Tribunal is composed of a Chairperson and not more than two Members appointed by the Central Government.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the composition of the Appellate Tribunal.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement defines the structure and appointment process of the Appellate Tribunal.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Chairperson or Members of the Appellate Tribunal must be appointed in consultation with the Chief Justice of India or his nominee.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Confirm that the Central Government consults the Chief Justice of India or his nominee when appointing the Chairperson or Members of the Appellate Tribunal.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the appointment process of the Appellate Tribunal.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement outlines the consultation process for appointments.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Chairperson or Members of the Appellate Tribunal must meet specific qualifications for appointment.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that the qualifications for appointment as Chairperson or Member of the Appellate Tribunal are met.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the appointment of the Appellate Tribunal.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement outlines the qualifications for appointment to the Appellate Tribunal.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Chairperson of the Appellate Tribunal must retire upon reaching the age of seventy years.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the Chairperson of the Appellate Tribunal retires upon reaching the age of seventy years.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the retirement age of the Chairperson of the Appellate Tribunal.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement sets the retirement age for the Chairperson of the Appellate Tribunal.

parsed_entries.requirement: Other Members of the Appellate Tribunal must retire upon reaching the age of sixty-five years.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify that other Members of the Appellate Tribunal retire upon reaching the age of sixty-five years.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the retirement age of other Members of the Appellate Tribunal.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement sets the retirement age for other Members of the Appellate Tribunal.

parsed_entries.requirement: The salary, allowances, and terms of service of the Chairperson or Members of the Appellate Tribunal cannot be varied to their disadvantage after appointment.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Confirm that the salary, allowances, and terms of service of the Chairperson or Members of the Appellate Tribunal cannot be varied to their disadvantage after appointment.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to the terms of service of the Appellate Tribunal members.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement ensures that the terms of service of the Appellate Tribunal members are protected after appointment.
